# FilterBar

## Description
FilterBar narrows the list under it: a search box, a few inline filters, a "More filters" panel for rare ones, the active filters as removable chips, and the result count.

`import { FilterBar, MoreFilterField, type FilterChip } from "@/components/app"`, source `components/app/filter-bar.tsx`, status `ready-with-gaps`.
Foundation: `@base-ui/react Popover` for the "More filters" panel, the rest hand-rolled. Traps checked: `trap/field-label` (ARIA), `trap/field-input-type` (ARIA), `trap/native-control` (Foundation), `trap/touch-input-zoom` (States, finding), `trap/overlay-title` (ARIA), `trap/overlay-focus-return` (Keyboard), `trap/overlay-conditional-render` n/a because `Popover.Root` stays mounted and owns the open state, `trap/escape-nested` (Keyboard), `trap/overlay-no-max-height` (States), `trap/open-trigger-unfocused` (States), `trap/focus-ring-shape` (Keyboard, finding), `trap/live-region-double` (ARIA), `trap/numbers-shift` (Tokens), `trap/hover-unguarded` n/a because no hover rule changes display, visibility or opacity.

### Foundation
| Given by the foundation | Added by the team |
|---|---|
| `Popover.Root`, `Trigger`, `Portal`, `Positioner`, `Popup` and `Title` from `@base-ui/react/popover`: open state, outside click and Escape to close, focus return to the trigger, `data-popup-open` on the trigger, `--available-height` | The "More filters" trigger with the `moreActiveCount` badge, a popup capped at `min(75vh, var(--available-height))` that scrolls, and a two-column grid from `sm` up when `more` holds 3 or more fields (`moreColumns` overrides it) |
| Nothing for search, chips or the result line | A native `<input type="search">` with an `sr-only` label, chips with a "Remove filter" button each, "Clear all", and a result line in `aria-live="polite"`. Hand-rolled because the bar predates the ui `Input` and needs the icon inside the field box |
| Nothing | `MoreFilterField`, a `label` plus control wrapper for fields inside `more`, with an optional `htmlFor` |

Example: Search for ingredients with one inline status filter and a result count (`docs/system/examples/filter-bar/default.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterBar } from '@/components/app';
import { FilterSelect } from '@/components/filter-select';

export default function FilterBarDefault() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('all');
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search ingredients', label: 'Search ingredients' }}
      filters={
        <FilterSelect
          size="compact"
          ariaLabel="Stock status"
          value={status}
          onChange={setStatus}
          options={[
            { value: 'all', label: 'All stock' },
            { value: 'low', label: 'Low stock' },
          ]}
        />
      }
      resultLabel="24 ingredients"
    />
  );
}
```

## Variants

### moreColumns
- `true`: the "More filters" panel is 42rem wide with two columns from `sm` up. The default when `more` holds 3 or more fields, counted through fragments. Used at 4 call sites by default (sales, suppliers, audit, POS transactions) and passed explicitly at 0.
- `false`: the panel is 20rem wide with one stacked column. The default under 3 fields. Used at 4 call sites by default (churn, users, stock, POS shifts).

Example: Audit log bar whose More filters panel lays three fields out in two columns (`docs/system/examples/filter-bar/more-columns-true.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterBar, MoreFilterField } from '@/components/app';
import { FilterSelect } from '@/components/filter-select';

const ALL = [{ value: 'All', label: 'All' }];

export default function FilterBarMoreColumns() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [entity, setEntity] = useState('All');
  const [module, setModule] = useState('All');
  const [agent, setAgent] = useState('All');
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search by user or action', label: 'Search audit log' }}
      more={
        <>
          <MoreFilterField label="Record type">
            <FilterSelect ariaLabel="Record type" value={entity} onChange={setEntity} options={[...ALL, { value: 'Sale', label: 'Sale' }]} />
          </MoreFilterField>
          <MoreFilterField label="Module">
            <FilterSelect ariaLabel="Module" value={module} onChange={setModule} options={[...ALL, { value: 'pos', label: 'POS' }]} />
          </MoreFilterField>
          <MoreFilterField label="User">
            <FilterSelect ariaLabel="User" value={agent} onChange={setAgent} options={[...ALL, { value: 'ada', label: 'Ada Okafor' }]} />
          </MoreFilterField>
        </>
      }
      moreColumns
      moreActiveCount={[entity, module, agent].filter((v) => v !== 'All').length}
      resultLabel="1,204 entries"
    />
  );
}
```

Example: Stock bar whose More filters panel stays one column with a single SKU field (`docs/system/examples/filter-bar/more-columns-false.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';

  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [sku, setSku] = useState('all');
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search product or SKU', label: 'Search stock' }}
      more={
        <MoreFilterField label="SKU">
          <FilterSelect ariaLabel="SKU" value={sku} onChange={setSku} options={[{ value: 'all', label: 'All SKUs' }, { value: 'tom-1kg', label: 'Tomatoes 1kg' }]} />
        </MoreFilterField>
      }
      moreColumns={false}
```

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rest | No filter differs from its default | Type a search, change an inline filter, open "More filters" | No chip row. The result line shows when the caller passes `resultLabel` | screenshot |
| Searching | Text in the search box | Edit or clear the text with the native clear control | The typed text in the field. Callers add a `"{query}"` chip once the URL holds it | by hand |
| Search focused | Focus in the search box | Type | 2px `outline-ring` outline around the field | by hand |
| More open | Click, Enter or Space on "More filters" | Change fields in the panel, close with Escape or an outside click | Panel titled "More filters", `aria-expanded="true"` and `data-popup-open` on the trigger, which keeps its muted fill | snapshot |
| More active | `moreActiveCount` above 0 | Open the panel to see or reset those fields | A round badge with the number on the trigger | screenshot |
| Filtered | `chips` holds one or more chips | Remove one chip, or all with "Clear all" when `onClearAll` is passed | A second row of chips, each with an X button named "Remove filter: {label}" | a11y scan |
| Loading | The caller's list is fetching and it passes `resultLabel={undefined}` | Keep filtering | The result line is absent, so no stale count is read | by hand |
| Panel taller than the screen | More fields than fit in `min(75vh, --available-height)` | Scroll inside the panel | A scrollbar inside the panel; the page does not move | by hand |
| Trigger hover | Pointer over "More filters" | Click | Pointer only, background changes to muted | by hand |

Example: Two active filters shown as removable chips, with Clear all and the result count (`docs/system/examples/filter-bar/filtered.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterBar, type FilterChip } from '@/components/app';

export default function FilterBarFiltered() {
  const [till, setTill] = useState<string | null>('Front till');
  const [q, setQ] = useState('jollof');
  const chips: FilterChip[] = [
    ...(till ? [{ key: 'till', label: `Till: ${till}`, onRemove: () => setTill(null) }] : []),
    ...(q ? [{ key: 'q', label: `"${q}"`, onRemove: () => setQ('') }] : []),
  ];
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search transactions', label: 'Search transactions' }}
      chips={chips}
      onClearAll={() => { setTill(null); setQ(''); }}
      resultLabel="18 transactions"
    />
  );
}
```

Example: While the list loads the caller passes no result label, so the count row stays empty (`docs/system/examples/filter-bar/loading.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterBar } from '@/components/app';

export default function FilterBarLoading() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const loading = true;
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search recipes', label: 'Search recipes' }}
      resultLabel={loading ? undefined : '12 recipes'}
    />
  );
}
```

### State precedence
- More open and more active: both show. The badge stays on the trigger while the panel is open.
- More open and trigger hover: more open wins. The trigger keeps its open fill when the pointer leaves.
- Filtered and loading: both show. Chips stay while the count line is absent, so the person still sees what is filtering.
- Rest and filtered: Not applicable: rest means the chip list is empty, filtered means it is not.
- Searching and filtered: both show. A search chip joins the others once the caller adds it.

### Motion
| Trigger | Kind | Preset | Properties | Reduced motion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pointer enters or leaves "More filters" | input | `transition-colors` (Tailwind default 150ms, no app preset exists in `app/globals.css`) | background-color | Same 150ms colour change. Nothing moves, so nothing is removed |
| Panel opens or closes | announce | `instant`, the popup has no enter or exit animation class | none | Same, it appears at once |

## Props

<!-- Props generated from components/app/filter-bar.tsx with TypeScript by scripts/props-table.mjs -->
### FilterBar

| Prop | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chips?` | `FilterChip[]` | `[]` | Active filters as removable chips. |
| `className?` | `string` |  |  |
| `filters?` | `ReactNode` |  | Up to 4 compact controls shown inline: LocationSelect, PeriodSelect, FilterSelect. |
| `more?` | `ReactNode` |  | Rarely used filters, shown in a "More filters" popover. |
| `moreActiveCount?` | `number` | `0` | How many filters inside `more` are active (shown on the button). |
| `moreColumns?` | `boolean` |  | Two-column "More filters" panel. |
| `onClearAll?` | `(() => void)` |  |  |
| `resultLabel?` | `ReactNode` |  | e.g. |
| `search?` | `{ value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; placeholder?: string; label?: string; }` |  |  |
| `trailing?` | `ReactNode` |  | Right-aligned extras (view toggle, export). |

### MoreFilterField

| Prop | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `htmlFor?` | `string` |  |  |

- `search` takes `value`, `onChange`, `placeholder` and `label`. `label` names the field for screen readers; without it the placeholder is used, then "Search".
- `filters` is a slot for 4 or fewer compact controls, per the JSDoc. Nothing enforces the cap.
- `more` holds fields wrapped in `MoreFilterField`. Fragments are looked through when counting fields for `moreColumns`.
- `moreActiveCount` is computed by the caller. The bar does not inspect `more`.
- `chips` is a list of `FilterChip` (`key`, `label`, `onRemove`). "Clear all" renders only when `chips` is not empty and `onClearAll` is passed.
- `resultLabel` sits in `aria-live="polite"`, so every change is read aloud.
- `trailing` is right-aligned with `ml-auto` on the first row.

## Usage

### When to use
- A list or table screen where people narrow rows by search and by one to four common fields, with rarer fields one click away.
- A dashboard or tab that needs location and period controls in one row above its content.

### When not to use
- Switching between whole sections of a page, not filtering one list. Use SectionTabs instead.
- Picking only a date range with no list to filter. Use PeriodSelect on its own instead.
- Two or three mutually exclusive views of the same list. Use Segmented instead.

### Rules
- `rule/filter-bar-more-field`: When a control goes inside `more`, wrap it in `MoreFilterField` with a `label`, because the panel gives the control no other visible label and the two-column grid sizes each wrapper as one cell. Evidence: app 8/8 bars that pass `more` wrap its fields in `MoreFilterField` (20 tags); principle heuristic: visible labels on every field. Check: review the `more` slot at each call site.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar more={<FilterSelect ariaLabel="Till" value={till} onChange={setTill} options={tills} />} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar more={<MoreFilterField label="Till"><FilterSelect ariaLabel="Till" value={till} onChange={setTill} options={tills} /></MoreFilterField>} />`
- `rule/filter-bar-more-count`: When `more` is passed, pass `moreActiveCount` with the number of fields in it that differ from their default, because a closed panel otherwise hides that rows are being filtered out. Evidence: app 8/8 bars with `more` pass `moreActiveCount`, such as `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:205`; principle heuristic: visibility of system status. Check: review that `more=` and `moreActiveCount=` appear together.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar more={tillField} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar more={tillField} moreActiveCount={till ? 1 : 0} />`
- `rule/filter-bar-clear-all`: When `chips` can hold 2 or more chips, pass `onClearAll` too, because "Clear all" renders only when both are set and removing chips one by one takes one press each. Evidence: app 8/11 bars with chips pass `onClearAll`, strays `app/(app)/inventory/requests-tab.tsx:141`, `app/(app)/inventory/stock-tab.tsx:176` and `app/(app)/settings/users-section.tsx:114`. Check: review.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar chips={chips} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar chips={chips} onClearAll={() => set({ till: null, cashier_id: null, q: null })} />`

### Content
- `rule/filter-bar-search-label`: When `search` is passed, set `search.label` to "Search {records}" and the placeholder to the fields searched, because the placeholder disappears once someone types and the label is the field's only lasting name. Evidence: app 17/18 bars with search set a label apart from the placeholder, such as `app/(app)/customers/page.tsx:185`, stray `app/(app)/pos/pos-filter-bar.tsx:27`; principle wcag: 3.3.2 labels or instructions. Check: review.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ }} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search name, phone, email, company', label: 'Search customers' }} />`
- `rule/filter-bar-chip-label`: When a chip stands for a field filter, label it `{Field}: {value}` in sentence case, and a search chip `"{query}"` in quotes, because the chip row is the only place a filter set inside the closed panel stays visible. Evidence: app 9/11 chip builders use `{Field}: {value}` or `"{query}"`, such as `app/(app)/pos/transactions.tsx:31` and `app/(app)/credits/page.tsx:138`, strays `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:139` ("By {name}") and `app/(app)/inventory/stock-tab.tsx:145` ("{n} SKUs"). Check: review.
  - Don't: `{ key: 'till', label: tillLabel(till), onRemove }`
  - Do: `{ key: 'till', label: \`Till: ${tillLabel(till)}\`, onRemove }`
- `rule/filter-bar-result-label`: When `resultLabel` is passed, write `{count} {noun}` with the singular noun for 1, and pass `undefined` while the list loads, because the line is announced on every change and a stale "0 sales" during a fetch is read as a result. Evidence: single use `components/app/filter-bar.tsx:80`; app 6/6 counted callers pass `undefined` while loading, such as `app/(app)/kitchen/jobs.tsx:210` and `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:208`. Check: review.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar resultLabel={\`${rows.length} sales\`} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar resultLabel={list.data ? plural(rows.length, 'sale') : undefined} />`

### Anti-slop
- `rule/filter-bar-no-hand-row`: When a list screen needs a search box beside filters, render `FilterBar` instead of a flex row with a raw `<input type="search">`, because the bar carries the `sr-only` label, the polite result line and the chip row that a hand-built row drops. Evidence: app 19/20 search boxes on list screens render through `FilterBar`, stray `app/(app)/sales/sales-filter-bar.tsx:82` inside a picker. Check: lint `rg -n 'type="search"' app components lib` outside `components/app/`.
  - Don't: `<div className="flex gap-2"><input type="search" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} /></div>`
  - Do: `<FilterBar search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search recipes', label: 'Search recipes' }} />`
- `rule/filter-bar-trailing-actions`: When an action such as Export or a view toggle sits with the filters, pass it in `trailing` instead of `filters`, because `trailing` is pushed right with `ml-auto` and keeps actions apart from the controls that narrow the list. Evidence: single use `components/app/filter-bar.tsx:76`; app 5/19 bars pass actions in `trailing`, such as `app/(app)/kitchen/jobs.tsx:199`. Check: review.
  - Don't: `<FilterBar filters={<><StatusFilter /><Button variant="outline">Export</Button></>} />`
  - Do: `<FilterBar filters={<StatusFilter />} trailing={<Button variant="outline">Export</Button>} />`

### Limits
Not applicable: the JSDoc cap of 4 inline filters is not measured yet at the narrowest width, so it is reported as a finding with a proposed gate instead of a rule.

## Accessibility
Rests on a native `<label>` around `<input type="search">`, native `<button>` elements, and the Base UI Popover dialog.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tab | Anywhere in the bar | Moves through search, inline filters, "More filters", trailing, then each chip's remove button and "Clear all" | The next control in DOM order | by hand |
| Enter or Space | "More filters" | Opens the panel | Inside the panel, on the popup, per Base UI | by hand |
| Escape | Inside the panel | Closes the panel. A select open inside it closes first, since Base UI closes the topmost layer | The "More filters" trigger | by hand |
| Enter or Space | A chip's remove button | Removes that filter | The button unmounts, so focus drops to the page body (finding) | by hand |
| Enter or Space | "Clear all" | Removes every chip | The row unmounts, so focus drops to the page body (finding) | by hand |
| Escape | Search box | Native: clears the text | Stays in the search box | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Search box | searchbox | `sr-only` label text: `search.label`, else placeholder, else "Search" | `type="search"` | "Search customers, search field" | a11y scan |
| "More filters" trigger | button | Its text "More filters" plus the badge number | `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, from Base UI | "More filters 2, button, collapsed" | snapshot |
| Panel | dialog | `Popover.Title` "More filters" | `aria-labelledby` to the title | "More filters, dialog" on open | snapshot |
| MoreFilterField label | none (label) | Its `label` text | Binds to the control only when `htmlFor` matches the control's `id` | The label when the bound control takes focus | by hand |
| Chip remove button | button | `aria-label` "Remove filter: {label}" | none | "Remove filter: Till: Front till, button" | a11y scan |
| Result line | none, live region | Its text | `aria-live="polite"` | The new count after each change, once. The bar has the only live region, so no double read | by hand |

## Related
- PeriodSelect: the period control that goes in `filters` on 6 bars.
- SectionTabs: switches whole sections; a FilterBar then filters the list inside one section.
- Segmented: two or three views of one list, where a filter row would be heavier.
- FilterSelect: compact filters in the `filters` slot.
